_comment: Merge this fragment into ~/.claude/settings.json's hooks. Don't overwrite the file.
Install prerequisite: installed via install.sh, or ln -s <repo>/bin/omhc ~/.local/bin/omhc
Listed in this order (mark, then brief) for readability, but Claude Code
starts both SessionStart hooks in this group at (measured) the same
instant — mark is not guaranteed to have already recorded this session
in the ledger by the time brief runs. brief tolerates either order: it
collects the other harness's foreign-session state itself if mark
hasn't gotten there first (#50), and due() excludes my_session_id, so a
session never hands off to itself either way.
Specifies --wire claude explicitly. It doesn't guess the platform from an
env var because omhc is a settings hook, not a plugin, so CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT
is never set. And emitting both additional_context and hookSpecificOutput
at once would have Claude Code read both without deduping, injecting the
UserPromptSubmit (v2 phase 2, #42): `omhc turn` warns, once per human
turn, when the other harness modified a file this session already
touched. This is a separate trust/approval unit from SessionStart above —
